name: MovieDB
description: MovieDB (moviedb.wiki) — Movies & TV with a one-call playback resolve: a single API request returns the adaptive HLS stream plus every subtitle language the source carries (English first). Every play offers the player's server list every verified route — the primary VidLove server plus live VidZen backups when the title has them. Two independent providers with automatic failover and seven per-source variants; playback starts from a direct id route with a background prefetch, so Open-to-play never re-fetches a catalogue page and every resolve is byte-validated. Public beta for all-user testing — playback reports welcome in the Discord support channels. TEST-only TV catalogue mapping and fallback-group metadata candidate; movie mapping and provider behavior unchanged.
